subject: Use kqueue as the backend of AE on DragonFlyBSD (#450)
reason: The change is a platform-detection tweak in src/config.h: it adds __DragonFly__ to the preprocessor check that defines HAVE_KQUEUE, so DragonFlyBSD builds use the kqueue AE backend instead of select. On Linux, where the fuzzer runs, HAVE_EPOLL still selects epoll and the compiled code is byte-for-byte unaffected by this diff. No runtime path reachable in this CI differs between the change and its parent, so no scenario can exercise it.
